subject: Medford Senior Center Services and Outreach
overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Director of Elder Affairs Pam Kelly regarding the programs, funding, and support services available to Medford seniors. Kelly provided details on membership, volunteer opportunities, transportation, and health insurance counseling offered through the Senior Center.

items.title: Introduction and Professional Background
items.summary: Director of Elder Affairs Pam Kelly discussed her professional background in the travel industry and her 18-year tenure managing the Medford Senior Center.

items.title: Membership and Participation Process
items.summary: Residents aged 60 and older can join the Senior Center for free by completing a participant form to receive a barcode card for program tracking.

items.title: Staffing and Volunteer Operations
items.summary: The facility is operated by four paid staff members and a network of 106 volunteers who handle reception, lunch service, and instructional classes.

items.title: Data Tracking and Grant Funding
items.summary: Participant demographic data is used to secure state and federal grants based on Medford's population of 12,744 residents over age 60.

items.title: Residency Requirements and Targeted Services
items.summary: While many programs have an open-door policy, grant-funded services such as the handyman program and social work are restricted to Medford residents.

items.title: Monthly Newsletter and Distribution
items.summary: The monthly newsletter, 'Our Place, Our Time,' provides activity schedules and event details to 100 locations across the city and via email.

items.title: Transportation and Parking Logistics
items.summary: Kelly detailed senior parking permits and the free door-to-door transportation service provided to residents by Megan Transportation.

items.title: Medicare Counseling and Housing Assistance
items.summary: The center provides SHINE counseling for Medicare open enrollment and guidance on navigating application processes for local senior housing developments.
